coordinate_convention: world axes; absolute center of mass position
interpretation: Measured differences; inspect terrain/contact/input contamination before changing tuning

orientation.interpretation: Full basis rotation error remains valid through rollover; roll excluded near vertical pitch

wheel_contact_counts.scope: grounded wheel counts; individual flags compared separately when available

switch_timing.interpretation: Steering signs use quantized bytes; gear uses the retail index including reverse/neutral. Positive timing differences mean native later. Unmatched decisions are reported separately.
